plan_version: D01 V3.1 — Five-Period Strategic Planning & Execution

north_star.vision_zh: 2027年底获得稳定正式全职风险岗位，争取Senior Analyst或等效职级与CAD 100,000–110,000年基本工资，并通过业务成果、风险分析能力和项目领导经验为Market Risk、Credit Methodology、CCR方向的未来Manager Scope打基础。
north_star.career_horizon_2030: Manager scope or above in Market Risk / Credit Methodology / CCR

contingencies.action: 工作成果和内部晋升优先，保留外部选择权

contingencies.trigger: 只有短期合同延期、没有批准的PFT
contingencies.action: 维持合法工作和收入，积极申请外部正式岗位
就业、现金流和工作资格优先；激活全面外部求职

contingencies.trigger: BMO PFT但2027Q3仍无可信晋升路径
contingencies.action: 保留职位并扩大外部Senior Analyst/高质量岗位市场测试

contingencies.trigger: 外部平级但明显更高的专业成长机会
contingencies.action: 用薪资25/Scope25/成长25/专业匹配15/团队稳定10的评分框架比较，不唯Title

cross_domain_rules: PFT和PR/TCF NCLC7同为最高优先事项；有就业风险时临时优先求职
每周工作外职业发展投入参考10–12小时，可随季调整而非刚性承诺
只按可验证证据计算成果，禁止泄露雇主保密资料
Stretch文章与研究可降级，不得挤占P0/P1

policy.must_target_stretch: Level of achievement within each objective; priority is not achievement level
policy.tracking_rule: Do not default new goals or KPIs to achieved; verify against dated evidence
policy.privacy: Do not commit salary, employer-confidential facts, health records, or personal tracker backups to public repositories

decision_preferences.specialization: Flexible among Credit Risk, Methodology, Market Risk, CCR
